name: Southern Muntenia
summary: Muntenia is a historical region in southern Romania, a component part of Wallachia. Its boundaries are: to the north the Carpathian Mountains, to the west the Olt River, to the south and east the Danube River, and to the north-east the Milcov, Putna, and Siret rivers.

sources.title: Ethnographic zones – Museum of the Romanian Peasant
sources.excerpt: Located in southern Muntenia, the Teleorman ethnographic area occupies the central part of the Romanian Plain. Representative villages: Suhaia, Drăgănești Vlașca.
